proposed.name: agent_r2_measurement_0
proposed.rationale: Interaction between tapping interval dispersion (IQR) and fatigue (decline in second-half rate); dimensionless motor control variability under endurance load.

proposed.name: agent_r2_measurement_1
proposed.rationale: Log-transformed pitch variability multiplied by log-transformed step length; dimensionless cross-modal combination of vocal control and gait spatial parameter.

proposed.name: agent_r2_measurement_2
proposed.rationale: Coefficient of variation of inter-tap intervals multiplied by short-term amplitude shimmer; dimensionless product of motor timing irregularity and vocal amplitude instability.

proposed.name: agent_r2_measurement_3
proposed.rationale: Absolute deviation from equal button use multiplied by mean zero-crossing rate; dimensionless combination of motor lateral asymmetry and vocal signal noise/aperiodicity.

proposed.name: agent_r2_integration_0
proposed.rationale: Coefficient of variation of inter-tap intervals multiplied by local amplitude shimmer; dimensionless cross-modal measure of motor rhythm irregularity and vocal amplitude instability.

proposed.name: agent_r2_integration_1
proposed.rationale: Log-transformed tapping interval interquartile range multiplied by log-transformed vocal spectral rolloff; captures potential relationship between motor timing spread and voice high-frequency energy distribution.

proposed.name: agent_r2_integration_2
proposed.rationale: Tapping fatigue (decline in second half) multiplied by walking step length; dimensionless interaction between fine motor endurance and gross motor stride pattern.
